text:
maya: quick sync — i've sketched a compact mapping for client-visible errors we can use for both API and console badging. want ops + ux take before i land an RFC.

devon: thanks. do you mean a *replacement* for the current 429/5xx mix or just tighter semantics?

maya: tighter semantics. keep 429 for quota-related throttles, 503 for capacity/backpressure, 424 for downstream-dep failures; also expose an `x-rw-reason` + `x-rw-retry-hint` header for client hints.

sai: can we avoid a new header name explosion? we already have `x-rw-route` and `x-rw-tenant`. how about piggybacking a single `x-rw-signal` JSON blob?

lex: +1 on compactness, but blobs break observability tooling and dashboards. our parsers want flat header -> tag mapping.

sofia: for console badges we need an explicit bucket: [ok, degraded, throttled, unavailable]. mapping should be deterministic from status+header. UX copy must be < 80 chars.

maya: proposal (short):
```
429 + header: reason=quota -> badge: throttled, retry_hint: Retry-After or x-rw-retry-hint secs
503 + header: reason=backpressure -> badge: degraded, retry_hint: none (soft-fail)
424 + header: reason=downstream -> badge: unavailable, retry_hint: contact-support
5xx generic -> badge: unavailable, retry_hint: try-later
```

rui: what about non-idempotent requests? exposing retry hints might cause duplicate work for customers. need to flag retryable vs non-retryable in telemetry.

devon: can we add `x-rw-retryable: true|false`? simple, parseable.

lex: fine for header, but ensure telemetry also logs `retryable` as a metric tag so gradeboard/alerts can split noisy retries.

sofia: console copy example for throttled: "Rate limit reached — requests paused. Retry after {n}s or request higher quota." short + actionable. for degraded: "Service degraded — responses may be slow. No automatic retry recommended."

maya: nice. rollout plan idea: start with internal tenant and canary traffic -> add telemetry tag `client_surface_bucket` so dashboards can show adoption. then 2-week canary, then default on.

ops-bot: deploy preview created for branch `error-taxonomy/headers` — preview link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/preview/1253

rui: one more operational ask — when we switch badges, we need a migration mapping for historical events in S3 -> run a small reclassification job so charts keep continuity.

devon: agree. i'll add a recorded migration step to the RFC.

lex: from infra side, please add a circuit-breaker metric for backpressure spikes. helps avoid mislabeling capacity issues as quota.

maya: thanks all — i'll update the RFC with header names `x-rw-reason`, `x-rw-retryable`, `x-rw-retry-hint` and badge buckets, add migration plan + telemetry tags, then ping again for sign-off.

sofia: tagging ux-owners: @sofia (me) will prep console copy snippets.

ops-bot: canary rollout scheduled at 2024-11-04T04:00Z on `canary-2` (50% traffic).
